groups.defect: The 'Imported from' footer interpolates an unescaped URL into HTML stored as raw_html and rendered with raw (XSS). Imported feed/page content is also stored without sanitization, and CGI.unescapeHTML in poll_feed decodes escaped HTML into live tags.
groups.rationale: All three report the unescaped URL interpolation at topic_embed.rb:13, which leads to XSS. Two of them also report that imported content is stored unsanitized, so the merged comment has to carry both points.

groups.defect: request.referer is echoed without escaping into a JavaScript string literal in the embed layout, which allows script injection.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same line in layouts/embed.html.erb and describe the same JS-string injection through the referer.

groups.defect: `<%- end if %>` in best.html.erb is a Ruby syntax error, so the template fails to compile and returns a 500.
groups.rationale: Both report the same dangling `if` on line 6 and propose the same fix.

groups.defect: poll_feed calls i.content.scrub without a guard, so a feed item with no content crashes the whole import loop (retry is disabled). One member also flags that String#scrub may be missing on older Ruby versions and that a nil title can break the insert.
groups.rationale: Both report the same nil-content crash at poll_feed.rb:35. s_42e6661a adds extra issues that the merged comment must keep.
